entries.title: Luke 24:1
segments: And [on] the first of the sabbaths, while still very early, they came to the tomb bringing the spices which they had prepared, and certain others with them.

entries.title: Luke 24:2
segments: But they found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

entries.title: Luke 24:3
segments: And going in, they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus.

entries.title: Luke 24:4
segments: And as they were much perplexed about it, it happened that, behold, two men stood by them in shining garments.

entries.title: Luke 24:5
segments: And as they were afraid, and bowed [their] faces down to the earth, they said to them, Why do you seek the living among the dead?

entries.title: Luke 24:6
segments: He is not here, but has risen. Remember how He spoke to you when He was still in Galilee,

entries.title: Luke 24:7
segments: saying, The Son of man must be delivered into [the] hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?

entries.title: Luke 24:8
segments: And they remembered His words

entries.title: Luke 24:9
segments: and returned from the tomb and told all these things to the Eleven and to the rest.

entries.title: Luke 24:10
segments: It was Mary Magdalene, and Joanna, and Mary [the mother] of James, and the rest with them, who told these things to the apostles.

entries.title: Luke 24:11
segments: And their words seemed to them like foolishness, and they did not believe them.

entries.title: Luke 24:12
segments: And Peter arose and ran to the tomb, and stooping down he saw the linens lying alone. And he went away wondering to himself at what had happened.

entries.title: Luke 24:13
segments: And behold, two of them went that same day to a village called Emmaus, it being [about] sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 24:14
segments: And they talked to each other of all these things which had happened.

entries.title: Luke 24:15
segments: And while they talked and reasoned, it happened that Jesus Himself drew near and went with them.

entries.title: Luke 24:16
segments: But their eyes were held [so that] they could not know Him.

entries.title: Luke 24:17
segments: And He said to them, What words [are] these that you have with one another [as] you walk, and are so sad.

entries.title: Luke 24:18
segments: And one of them, whose name was Cleopas, answered and said to Him, [Are] you only a stranger in Jerusalem and have not known the things which have occurred there in these days?

entries.title: Luke 24:19
segments: And He said to them, What things? And they said to Him, The things concerning Jesus of Nazareth, who was a man, prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people,

entries.title: Luke 24:20
segments: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered Him to [the] judgement of death, and have crucified Him.

entries.title: Luke 24:21
segments: But we had trusted that He was the One who was about to redeem Israel. And besides all this, today is the third day since these things were done.

entries.title: Luke 24:22
segments: Yes, and also some of our women astounded us, having been early at the tomb;

entries.title: Luke 24:23
segments: and when they did not find His body, [they] came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that He was alive.

entries.title: Luke 24:24
segments: And some of those with us went to the tomb and found [it] even as the women had said. But they did not see Him.

entries.title: Luke 24:25
segments: And He said to them, O fools and slow of heart to believe all things that the prophets spoke!

entries.title: Luke 24:26
segments: Was it not necessary for the Christ to suffer these things and to enter into His glory?

entries.title: Luke 24:27
segments: And beginning at Moses and all the prophets, He expounded to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning Himself.

entries.title: Luke 24:28
segments: And they drew near the village where they were going. And He appeared to be going further.

entries.title: Luke 24:29
segments: But they constrained Him, saying, Stay with us, for it is toward evening and the day is far spent. And He went in to stay with them.

entries.title: Luke 24:30
segments: And it happened [as] He reclined with them, taking the loaf, He blessed [it], and breaking it, He gave to them.

entries.title: Luke 24:31
segments: And their eyes were opened, and they knew Him. And He became invisible to them.

entries.title: Luke 24:32
segments: And they said to one another, Did not our heart burn within us while He talked with us by the way and while He opened the Scriptures to us?

entries.title: Luke 24:33
segments: And they rose up the same hour and returned to Jerusalem and found assembled the Eleven and those with them.

entries.title: Luke 24:34
segments: And they said, the Lord has indeed risen, and has appeared to Simon.

entries.title: Luke 24:35
segments: And they told what things [had happened] in the way, and how He had been known by them in breaking of the loaf.

entries.title: Luke 24:36
segments: And as they spoke this, Jesus Himself stood in their midst, and said to them, Peace to you!

entries.title: Luke 24:37
segments: But they were terrified and filled with fear, for they thought they saw a spirit.

entries.title: Luke 24:38
segments: And He said to them, Why are you troubled, and why do thoughts arise in your hearts?

entries.title: Luke 24:39
segments: Behold My hands and My feet, that I am He! Handle Me and see, for a spirit does not have flesh and bones as you see Me have.

entries.title: Luke 24:40
segments: And when He had spoken this, He showed them [His] hands and feet.

entries.title: Luke 24:41
segments: And while they still did not believe for joy, and wondered, He said to them, Have you any food here?

entries.title: Luke 24:42
segments: And they handed to Him a piece of a broiled fish and of a honeycomb.

entries.title: Luke 24:43
segments: And He took [it] and ate before them.

entries.title: Luke 24:44
segments: And He said to them, These [are] the words which I spoke to you while I was still with you, that all things must be fulfilled which were written in the law of Moses and in the Prophets and [in] the Psalms about Me.

entries.title: Luke 24:45
segments: And He opened their mind to understand the Scriptures.

entries.title: Luke 24:46
segments: And He said to them, So it is written, and so it behoved Christ to suffer and to rise from [the] dead the third day,

entries.title: Luke 24:47
segments: and that repentance and remission of sins should be proclaimed in His name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

entries.title: Luke 24:48
segments: And you are witnesses of these things.

entries.title: Luke 24:49
segments: And behold, I send the promise of My father on you. But you sit in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.

entries.title: Luke 24:50
segments: And He led them out as far as Bethany. And lifting up His hands, He blessed them.

entries.title: Luke 24:51
segments: And it happened as He blessed them, He withdrew from them and was carried up into Heaven.

entries.title: Luke 24:52
segments: And worshiping Him, they returned to Jerusalem with great joy.

entries.title: Luke 24:53
segments: And they were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.
